title.narrative: Environmental awareness and sustainable problem-solving training

description.narrative: Increased adaptive capacity to climate change for underrepresented and vulnerable groups, particularly youth and women, through improved income generation opportunities and enhanced environmental awareness.

Through GGGI’s current “Creating Sustainable Green Jobs for Refugees and Host Communities through the Green Economy in Jordan”, GGGI has developed a proven ‘Environmental Awareness and Sustainable Problem-Solving’ training program. This training model is being expanded with the support of Irish Aid to the southern and central governorates of Jordan, building on the demonstrated effectiveness of the pilot phase of this training. This project focuses on building the climate resilience and employability of youth in Jordan, particularly women, by enhancing their green skills and fostering environmental awareness. The theory of change is driven by the understanding that equipping vulnerable and marginalized groups with key competencies in environmental sustainability, problem-solving, and climate resilience will improve their economic prospects while also contributing to Jordan’s green economy and sustainable development goals. Through green skills training, participants will have greater interest in green employment and more confidence in employment in emerging green sectors. At the same time, these trainees will become advocates for environmental awareness, influencing broader societal shifts toward sustainable practices.
